channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Alabama Digital Expansion Authority receives broadband updates from internet providers
item.description: ADECA Director Kenneth Boswell warned that Alabama risks losing over $400 million in federal funds if broadband projects are not completed on time.

item.title: Sen. Britt applauds Alabamians appointed to USDA FSA State Committee
item.description: Five Alabamians were appointed to the USDA Farm Service Agency State Committee, bringing decades of experience and expertise to crucial farm oversight roles.

item.title: Sen. Britt secures $50.7M for Alabama in FY26 spending package
item.description: Sen. Katie Britt, R-Alabama, secured over $50 million for state projects across three major spending bills, targeting infrastructure, space exploration, and law enforcement.

item.title: Rep. Barry Moore qualifies for U.S. Senate race
item.description: Qualifying for the Senate, Moore spoke about ushering in an “American Golden Age,” stressing his loyalty and experience under President Trump.

item.title: Opinion | An old shepherd’s battle for children, conscience and mercy
item.description: I witnessed and experienced the glory and the power of the Lord as it melted hearts and changed minds with truth and grace.

item.title: Rep. Moore receives Trump endorsement for Senate bid
item.description: Moore, who’s been polling behind Attorney General Steve Marshall, said he was “truly honored and thankful” for Trump’s endorsement.

item.title: Kenneth Traywick speaks out after 35-day hunger strike at Bullock prison
item.description: The prison reform advocate called his 35-day strike a “failure” after ADOC met none of his demands before medical issues forced him to stop.

item.title: This week on The V: Ivey legacy, turnout collapse, OTC ivermectin push
item.description: Gov. Kay Ivey’s final State of the State, the Tuberville contrast, turnout collapse in District 63, Ron Sparks’s return, and the ivermectin bill.

item.title: Opinion | Alabama disgraces itself by continuing to honor a traitor on MLK Day
item.description: No decent person could ever seriously justify honoring Robert E. Lee at all, much less on the same day the state honors MLK.

item.title: Opinion | When presidents begin to resemble kings
item.description: From Washington’s restraint to executive immunity, constitutional limits are fading and king-like authority is quietly reentering American political life.
